appliedUpdates.description: Document Vulkan descriptor set creation pattern: layout creation with vk::DescriptorSetLayoutCreateInfo, pool allocation, descriptor update with dst_array_element for array bindings, and RAII cleanup with VkDescriptorSetLayout wrapper
Document parameter passing pattern via objects[0] for fullscreen shaders (mirrors tonemapping shader approach)
Document ViewportRect shader format: [x, y, z, w] represents [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] for viewport positioning in shaders
Document backbuffer output format requirement: B8G8R8A8Srgb format is required for backbuffer rendering in material compilation

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature compositing-shader noted this pattern consistency across tonemapping.wgsl and composite.wgsl (lines 217-237). This is a repeatable pattern that should be documented as a convention.
